answer: Best chain: QB11-QB12-QB7, with QB12 in the middle. I used garnet's default calibration set f81c45da-6e73-4b5d-a0fe-72c75635fade. The CZ pair QB12-QB11 has an IRB fidelity of 0.998693 and QB12-QB7 has 0.998016. Their product is 0.996712. The runner-up is QB12-QB11-QB16 at 0.994689. All 28 garnet CZ loci had a fidelity value, and I ranked every 3-qubit chain. I ran the GHZ circuit on garnet:mock with 200 shots as native IQM JSON, so no transpiler could move it to other qubits. The circuit puts prx(pi/2, pi/2) on QB12, QB11 and QB7. It then applies cz on [QB12,QB11] and on [QB12,QB7], and those are the only two-qubit gates. Next it puts prx(pi/2, -pi/2) on QB11 and QB7, and it measures [QB11, QB12, QB7] under key m. Job 01a15fa3-c892-71fc-a679-0425f409d1f0 completed with counts 000:50, 011:52, 100:54, 111:44. Each bitstring reads QB11, QB12, QB7 from left to right. The mock returns made-up results that do not reflect the GHZ state, so 011 and 100 appear even though a real GHZ would give mostly 000 and 111. The API reported 1.0 billed seconds for this mock job.
